name: Midnight Blossoms
description: Small four-petal blossoms scattered in a mixed ink palette.

code.style: --rule: ( background-size: 300px 300px; background-color: var(--color1); background-image: @doodle( @grid: 16x1 / 100%; @place-cell: center; @size: 100%; visibility: hidden; @random(${shapeFrequency}) { visibility: visible; } background-image: @doodle( @grid: 1 / 80px; background: @p(var(--color2), var(--color3), var(--color4), var(--color5)); transform: rotate(@r(360deg)) scale(@r(.5, 1)); clip-path: @shape( split: 120; y: sin(2t) * sin(4t) * cos(5t); x: cos(2t) * cos(5t) * sin(t); ); ); background-position: @pn( -5px 10px, 65px 25px, 80px 90px, 110px -40px, -40px 120px, 40px 240px, 90px 180px, 150px 190px, 160px 40px, 220px 60px, 240px 240px, 210px 160px, 20px 150px, 160px 100px ); z-index: 2; @nth(15, 16) { z-index: 1; background: @m(90, ( radial-gradient( @p(var(--color2), var(--color3), var(--color4), var(--color5)) @r(50%), transparent 0 ) @r(100%) @r(100%) / @r(10px) @lr no-repeat )); } ); -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; );
